channel.title: Trinity Masculine
channel.description: Discipline, attention and one skill — free protocols for men.

item.title: How to Build Discipline in 7 Days (the actual protocol)
item.description: A seven-day protocol built on removal rather than motivation: one non-negotiable per day, a win condition for each one, and what day three really feels like.

item.title: Dopamine Detox for Men: What It Actually Does
item.description: The chemistry is a myth and the behaviour change is real. What a dopamine detox does, what it does not, the evidence, and a seven-day version you can start tonight.

item.title: A Morning Routine That Survives a Bad Day
item.description: Most routines die on the first morning you wake up flat. Here is the four-minute minimum version, the full version, and the rule that keeps both alive.

item.title: How to Pick One Skill and Give It 90 Days
item.description: Six skills that still work in 2026, a 30-60-90 plan built on daily output rather than courses, and an honest look at what deliberate practice does and does not explain.

item.title: How to Stop Scrolling Your Phone (That Actually Works)
item.description: Why deleting apps fails, the three changes that cut phone use without deleting anything, and the evidence from a 467-person randomised trial.

item.title: How to Make Money at 17 (Without a Fake Guru)
item.description: What actually works before you turn 18, the age rules nobody tells you about, a 90-day plan built on one service skill, and why nobody can promise you a number.
